name: asljs-toolkit
description: Repository maintenance commands for ASLJS projects.

scripts.format: npm run format:json && npm run format:ts && npm run format:sfmt
scripts.prepare: npm run build:dist --prefix ../../libs/logging && npm run build:dist --prefix ../../libs/locator && npm run build:dist
scripts.all: npm run clean && npm run format && npm run build:dist && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:md && npm run build && npm run test
